claim: Recorded checks, not a claim of objective AAA quality or completed child usability testing.

browserPlaythrough.pauseResumeRace: Root verified rapid resume+portrait leaves the pause menu and rotate overlay visible; returning to landscape and resuming works.
browserPlaythrough.savePersistence: Root verified game34 two-star result survives reload.
browserPlaythrough.existingStarlineMenu: normal, slow, expert and endless choices still available

automatedChecks.drawCoverage: 4 scenes × 81 multiplication facts × 2 viewport sizes × 2 motion settings × 3 outcomes
automatedChecks.resumeRaceRegression: Deferred audio resume followed by portrait rotation or page hiding stays paused, pauses resumed audio, keeps the modal visible, and still permits a later landscape resume.

observations: Central objects, characters, answer buttons and answer feedback have no blocking overlaps.
The normal keychain question hides its answer behind a question mark before submission.
Treasure bag quantities and copier group counts match the shown multiplication facts.
Success captures show the start of the intended paint, copy and unlock animations, not their final frames.
independentGroupCVisualReview.followUp: Final refreshed screenshots reviewed: shared instruction chip and scene count labels are separated; central game objects, characters and answer buttons remain clear at 667x375. Keychain also checked at 1280x720. No blocking overlap or normal-question answer spoiler found.
independentGroupCVisualReview.captureLimit: Original practice/success captures precede the stageTotal/layout update. Five final screenshots above verify the updated layout. The 3-question tour and 6-question solo mural completion conditions are separately regression-tested.

remainingValidationLimits: Desktop browser inspection does not establish real iPhone PWA audio, safe-area or touch performance.
A child playtest is still needed to assess first-time comprehension, learning retention and sustained enjoyment.
